name: Autonomous Active Experimentation and Neural Skill-Gap Recognition
hypothesis: When existing neural skill compositions exhibit ambiguous evidence margins (Delta S < 0.08), generating bounded active discriminative probes (budget <= 1-2 queries) that maximize candidate hypothesis disagreement significantly improves plan selection accuracy and end-to-end exact match over random and non-discriminative queries, resolves false abstentions on supported tasks, and preserves >=95% specificity on unsupported tasks, with strictly zero parameter growth.
architectural_principle: Adaptive Mini-GPT should learn before growing, reuse before learning, and verify before retaining any change.

evaluation_design.statistical_model: Paired Student-t test (df=4, t_crit=2.776 at 95% two-tailed)

success_criteria.query_usefulness: Active discriminative EM > Random and Non-discriminative
success_criteria.supported_abstention_reduction: Supported task false abstention < Frozen M78 (0.0750)
success_criteria.statistical_significance: p < 0.05 paired Student-t vs frozen baseline
